page.layout: One printed page: an engraved portrait frontispiece, with an oval portrait, allegorical figures at left and right, and a scroll with text at the foot. No running text or page number.
page.notes: Engraving: a bust portrait of a man in a full periwig and ermine-trimmed robes, within an oval framed by acanthus foliage. At left a figure in armour with a shield bearing arms; at right a seated female figure holding scales. The scroll at the foot carries a lion's head. The scroll lines are partly worn and blurred; the abbreviations and the signature line are doubtful. The title lines are transcribed as they appear on the scroll.
